theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.38%) and Industrials (+0.06%) led the market today, while Utilities (-1.69%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.41%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.83%, defensives -0.88%, and value/cyclicals +0.03% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.62%, Dow -0.60%, Nasdaq -1.01% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.26%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 3.87% to 14.76, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.39% to $4,319.20, crude oil was little changed at $92.50, and bitcoin slipped 2.40% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
